incidents.summary: A breach of the L.A. City Attorney’s Office exposed sensitive LAPD records. The stolen material reportedly included 337,000 files totaling 7.7 TB, including officer personnel files, internal affairs investigations, and discovery documents.

incidents.title: Alinto leak exposes 40 million emails linked to French companies
incidents.summary: A leak involving 40 million emails linked to major French companies was reported in connection with Alinto. The source does not describe how the data was accessed.

incidents.title: Ransomware attack disrupts ChipSoft hospital software
incidents.summary: ChipSoft was hit by ransomware around April 7, disrupting its electronic health record platform and prompting roughly a dozen Dutch hospitals to take software offline. Z-CERT said critical care processes had not halted; Embargo later claimed it stole 100 GB of data.

updates.text: Embargo claimed responsibility and said it had stolen 100 GB of data.

incidents.title: Ransomware attack takes Winona County systems offline
incidents.summary: Winona County detected a ransomware attack around April 6–7 and took systems including vital statistics and DMV services offline. Emergency services remained operational, and the county reported completing network recovery by April 24; a later breach notice listed 6,196 affected people.

updates.text: The county completed network recovery with support from federal and state response teams.
A breach notice listed 6,196 affected people.

incidents.title: Drift Protocol loses about $295 million in crypto attack
incidents.actor: North Korea-linked actors (attributed by Mandiant, according to Drift)
incidents.vector: Attackers used pre-signed Solana durable-nonce transactions to take administrative control
incidents.summary: Attackers used pre-signed durable-nonce transactions from Drift Security Council members to take administrative control of the protocol. Reported losses were about $295 million; Drift attributed the operation to North Korea-linked actors citing Mandiant.

incidents.title: Hundreds of Hungarian government credentials found in breach databases
incidents.vector: Password reuse on non-work platforms and credential-stealer logs
incidents.summary: Bellingcat reported that approximately 795 Hungarian government email addresses and associated passwords were circulating in online breach databases, affecting 12 of 13 ministries. The exposed credentials allegedly included accounts associated with military officers, diplomats and counter-terrorism staff.

incidents.title: EduConnect leak exposes 3.1 million student accounts
incidents.summary: More than 3.1 million student accounts on France’s EduConnect state platform were reportedly leaked. The source does not specify the cause or the exposed fields.

incidents.org: Venice San Marco flood defence pumps
incidents.title: Hackers claim control of Venice San Marco flood-defense pumps
incidents.vector: Unspecified system compromise
incidents.summary: Actors using the names Infrastructure Destruction Squad and Dark Engine claimed they had breached Venice’s San Marco flood-defense pump system and gained administrative control. They offered to sell root access for USD 600; the claim was not independently confirmed in the supplied reporting.

incidents.title: Basic-Fit breach exposes data of about one million members
incidents.vector: Cyberattack; specific method not stated
incidents.summary: Basic-Fit said attackers accessed its member-visit registration system on April 8, 2026, affecting about one million members across six countries. Exposed information included contact details, dates of birth, bank account details, and membership data.

incidents.title: Booking.com resets reservation PINs after customer data breach
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to Booking.com systems
incidents.summary: Booking.com said unauthorized access exposed reservation and user information, including names, email and postal addresses, phone numbers, and communications with property providers. The company did not disclose how many users were affected and said it was resetting reservation PINs and notifying users.

incidents.title: Cyberattack exposes pupils’ personal data at French Education Ministry
incidents.vector: Impersonation of an authorised staff account and exploitation of a vulnerability in an EduConnect-related service
incidents.summary: An attacker downloaded pupils’ personal data, including names, EduConnect identifiers, and school or class details. The ministry said the number of affected pupils was still being assessed.

French Ministry of Education pupil data leak

incidents.org: French nuclear deterrent communications ecosystem / DIRISI
incidents.title: Russia-linked operatives target French nuclear communications
incidents.vector: Reconnaissance of communications sites, infrastructure, staff, and contractors
incidents.summary: Russia-linked operatives reportedly conducted reconnaissance against France’s nuclear deterrent communications ecosystem, with activity said to have begun in early March. Reported targeting included transmission sites, continuity mechanisms, and DIRISI staff and contractors.

incidents.title: Rhea Finance exploit causes reported $18.4 million loss
incidents.vector: Margin parser treated fake swap-route minimums as collateral
incidents.summary: Rhea Finance suffered an exploit on April 16, 2026, with a reported loss of about $18.4 million. The reported cause was a margin parser treating fake swap-route minimums as collateral; about $9 million was frozen or recovered.

incidents.title: DDoS attack disrupts Bluesky platform and API
incidents.vector: DDoS attack targeting the API
incidents.summary: Bluesky said a DDoS attack caused intermittent outages beginning April 15, disrupting feeds, notifications, threads and search. Service stability was restored by April 16, and Bluesky reported no unauthorized access to private user data; 313 Team claimed responsibility.

incidents.title: Kraken Reports Extortion Threat After Insider-related Breach
incidents.vector: Access through employees
incidents.summary: Kraken said attackers threatened to release video showing internal systems that host client data, and that the access involved employees rather than a technical vulnerability. The company said about 2,000 customers were affected, funds were safe, and employees had been terminated.

incidents.title: Medtronic confirms breach affecting 3.83 million people
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to corporate IT systems
incidents.summary: Medtronic said an unauthorized party accessed certain corporate IT systems between approximately April 13 and 19, 2026. A filing listed 3,834,294 affected people; the company said its products and manufacturing and distribution operations were not affected.

incidents.title: 7-Eleven breach exposes personal information of 185,300 people
incidents.vector: Misconfigured Salesforce Aura guest-user permissions
incidents.summary: An unauthorized party accessed systems used to store 7-Eleven franchisee documents on April 8. ShinyHunters later published an archive; Have I Been Pwned identified 185,300 affected individuals, with exposed data including names, dates of birth, email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses.

updates.text: A later report said ShinyHunters claimed to have exposed more than 600,000 records; this claim differs from the 185,300 affected individuals reported by Have I Been Pwned.

incidents.title: McGraw Hill confirms data breach after extortion threat
incidents.vector: Misconfigured Salesforce page
incidents.summary: McGraw Hill confirmed that a misconfigured Salesforce page was exploited to access internal data, which the company described as limited and non-sensitive. ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen 45 million records, but that figure was not confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: University of Nebraska Medical Center reports data breach
incidents.summary: An official breach-notice table lists the University of Nebraska Medical Center as reporting a data breach. It reports 126,543 affected people; further incident details were not provided in the extraction.
match: University of Nebraska Medical Center data breach
University of Nebraska Medical Center breach

incidents.title: Innovative Scientific Solutions reports breach affecting 143,842 people
incidents.summary: An official breach-notice table lists Innovative Scientific Solutions, LLC as reporting a data breach. It reports 143,842 affected people; further incident details were not provided in the extraction.

incidents.org: Restaurant Management Co. of Wichita, Inc.
incidents.title: Restaurant Management Co. of Wichita reports data breach
incidents.summary: An official breach-notice table lists Restaurant Management Co. of Wichita, Inc. as reporting a data breach. It reports 120,416 affected people; further incident details were not provided in the extraction.
match: Restaurant Management Co. of Wichita data breach
Restaurant Management Co. of Wichita breach
Restaurant Management Co. of Wichita cyber incident

incidents.title: Leak exposes data on 1.9 million French Basketball Federation licence holders
incidents.summary: A leak exposed information on 1.9 million French Basketball Federation licence holders. The source also lists a May 3 leak at the federation that appears to refer to this incident.

incidents.title: Social-engineering attack exposes data of nearly six million Carnival customers
incidents.vector: Social engineering of an employee to obtain account access
incidents.summary: Carnival said an attacker used social engineering to compromise an employee account and access part of its IT systems on April 14. The company reported 5,995,277 affected people; exposed information varied by person and included names, contact details, dates of birth, and government ID numbers.

updates.text: A later report described the incident as affecting approximately six million people and said ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen 8.7 million records.

incidents.title: KelpDAO loses about $292 million in bridge theft
incidents.vector: Forged cross-chain message accepted through a route using a single verifier after verifier RPC nodes were compromised
incidents.summary: An attacker used a forged cross-chain message to drain about 116,500 rsETH from KelpDAO’s LayerZero bridge setup, valued at roughly $292 million. LayerZero described its North Korea/Lazarus Group attribution as preliminary; a later report said most of the affected rsETH had been recovered through liquidations by May 9.

updates.text: A later report said 106,993 rsETH had been recovered through liquidations by May 9.

incidents.title: Vercel breach traced to compromised third-party AI tool
incidents.vector: Compromised third-party AI tool OAuth app tied to an employee account
incidents.summary: Vercel said attackers used an employee work account to access internal systems, including customer credentials that were not encrypted. The company later found evidence of earlier compromise affecting a small number of customer accounts and said it notified customers it knew were affected.

updates.text: Vercel said it found evidence of an earlier compromise affecting a small number of customer accounts and had notified those it knew were affected.

incidents.title: Canada Life data breach listed in 2026
incidents.summary: The source lists a 2026 data breach at Canada Life. It provides no further details about the incident, affected information, or cause.

incidents.title: France Titres confirms breach affecting about 11.7 million accounts
incidents.vector: Reported API access-control flaw
incidents.summary: France Titres, the agency managing identity-document services, confirmed a security incident affecting approximately 11.7 million accounts. An attacker advertised 19 million records; that larger figure was not the government’s reported count, and the investigation was ongoing.

updates.text: France Titres published an investigation update concerning the provisional affected-account count and data types.
A minor was taken into custody over suspected involvement in the incident.

incidents.title: Rodenburg Law Firm reports breach affecting 119,895 people
incidents.summary: Rodenburg Law Firm reported a breach dating to August 2025; an official breach-notice table lists 119,895 affected people. Akira claimed the breach and said it stole 144 GB of data.

incidents.title: Finnish authorities investigate Valtori breach as suspected espionage
incidents.vector: Exploitation of a zero-day vulnerability in a commercial product
incidents.summary: Finnish police expanded their investigation into a January breach of Valtori’s mobile device management service to include suspected cyberespionage. About 50,000 users were affected, and the attacker accessed operational and personal data; compromise of data stored on devices was not confirmed.

incidents.title: Leak exposes images of French nuclear power plants linked to EDF
incidents.summary: A leak exposed images of French nuclear power plants in an incident involving EDF. The source provides no details about the images’ origin or the cause of the leak.

incidents.title: Ransomware group claims cyberattack on Engie
incidents.vector: Ransomware
incidents.summary: An unnamed ransomware group claimed a cyberattack on Engie. The source provides no further details or confirmation of the claim.

incidents.title: Seiko USA website defaced with customer-data theft claim
incidents.summary: A section of Seiko USA’s website was defaced with a message claiming attackers had stolen its Shopify customer database. The message listed customer and order information allegedly taken and threatened to leak the data unless a ransom was paid.

incidents.title: Malicious Bitwarden CLI release steals developer credentials
incidents.vector: Malicious preinstall hook in @bitwarden/cli version 2026.4.0
incidents.summary: The @bitwarden/cli 2026.4.0 npm package was maliciously available for about 90 minutes on April 22. Its preinstall hook harvested developer credentials and uploaded them to public GitHub repositories; Bitwarden said there was no evidence that end-user vault data was accessed or at risk.

incidents.title: City of Suffolk reports breach affecting 157,725 people
incidents.summary: The City of Suffolk reported a breach originating in February 2026 that affected 157,725 people. Cloak claimed responsibility and said it stole 2.5 TB of data.

incidents.title: Laurel Eye Clinic reports breach affecting 145,221 people
incidents.summary: An official breach-notice table lists Laurel Eye Clinic as reporting a data breach. The notice reports 145,221 affected people; further incident details were not provided in the extraction.

incidents.title: Rituals confirms breach of customer membership records
incidents.summary: Rituals said an unauthorized download in April contained customer membership information, including names, dates of birth, contact details, preferred stores and account types. The company did not provide a reliable number of affected customers.

incidents.title: Third-party breach exposes records of nearly 197,000 Zara customers
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to a third-party-hosted database
incidents.summary: Records tied to nearly 197,000 Zara customers were exposed through a third-party-hosted database. Reported information included email addresses, location, purchase details, and support tickets; passwords and payment card details were not reported as compromised.

incidents.title: Fraudulent access exposes data on 705,000 Parcoursup applicants
incidents.vector: Fraudulent access in Occitanie
incidents.summary: Data on 705,000 Parcoursup applicants was leaked after fraudulent access in Occitanie. The source does not identify the perpetrator or specify the exposed data fields.

incidents.title: Data on 500,000 UK Biobank volunteers listed for sale
incidents.vector: Data offered for sale on Alibaba
incidents.summary: Data said to concern 500,000 UK Biobank volunteers was listed for sale on Alibaba. The source does not say whether the listing was verified or how the data was obtained.

incidents.title: ADT confirms unauthorized access to customer data
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to cloud-based environments; ShinyHunters claimed a vishing entry
incidents.summary: ADT said it detected unauthorized access to customer and prospective-customer data on April 20 and stopped the intrusion. It reported exposure of names, phone numbers, and addresses, with dates of birth and partial identification numbers in a small percentage of cases; ADT said payment information was not accessed.

updates.text: A later roundup cited a report that the breach affected 5.5 million people, while an official breach-notice table listed 32,546.

incidents.title: GrayRobinson data breach affects 80,383 people
incidents.summary: GrayRobinson reported a data breach affecting 80,383 people, according to an official breach-notice listing. Other reports described the incident as involving stolen personal and health information.

incidents.title: Florida Physician Specialists data breach affects 276,498 people
incidents.summary: Florida Physician Specialists appears in an official breach-notice listing with 276,498 affected people. The supplied report does not provide details about the data involved or how the breach occurred.
match: Florida Physician Specialists patient data breach

incidents.title: Udemy data breach listed in 2026
incidents.summary: The source lists a 2026 data breach at Udemy. It provides no further details about the incident, affected information, or cause.

incidents.title: Pitney Bowes confirms customer data breach in Salesforce environment
incidents.vector: Salesforce environment
incidents.summary: Pitney Bowes confirmed unauthorized access to customer data in its Salesforce environment. ShinyHunters claimed the stolen dataset contained more than 25 million records; Have I Been Pwned identified about 8.2 million unique email addresses in the dataset.

incidents.title: Checkmarx-related development tool compromised in supply-chain campaign
incidents.vector: Compromised Checkmarx-related development tool
incidents.summary: A Checkmarx-related development tool was reportedly compromised in a supply-chain campaign. The roundup linked the activity to TeamPCP and described shared indicators with a Bitwarden package incident.

incidents.title: Vimeo user data exposed in Anodot third-party breach
incidents.vector: Third-party analytics vendor Anodot breach
incidents.summary: Vimeo said unauthorized access following a breach at analytics vendor Anodot exposed email addresses, technical data, video titles, and metadata. Vimeo said login credentials and financial information were not affected. Have I Been Pwned later reported 119,200 email addresses in the leaked dataset.

updates.text: Have I Been Pwned reported that email addresses belonging to 119,200 people were uploaded following the breach.

incidents.title: Sandhills Medical Foundation reports breach affecting 169,017 people
incidents.summary: Sandhills Medical Foundation notified 169,017 people of a breach stemming from May 2025. The INC ransomware group claimed the breach.

incidents.title: Sweat Economy loses $3.46 million in exploit
incidents.summary: Sweat Economy reportedly lost $3.46 million, about 65% of its liquidity pool, in an exploit lasting less than 30 seconds. The protocol said stolen funds were frozen on MEXC and recovery efforts were underway.

incidents.title: Spoofed radio signal triggers emergency stops on Taiwan High Speed Rail trains
incidents.vector: Suspected copying and spoofing of a radio handset’s signal parameters
incidents.summary: A spoofed radio signal triggered emergency stops on three Taiwan High Speed Rail trains, causing 48 minutes of delays. Prosecutors suspected that a handset signal had been copied and spoofed, and a university student was detained on April 28.
match: Taiwan High Speed Rail radio spoofing
Taiwan High Speed Rail emergency-stop incident

incidents.title: Everest claims theft of Liberty Mutual policyholder data
incidents.summary: Everest claimed to have stolen more than 108 GB of policyholder data involving Liberty Mutual. Liberty Mutual said its initial investigation found no evidence of a compromise of its own systems and indicated the incident may be linked to a third-party vendor.

incidents.title: Pro-Iran 313 Team claims DDoS disruption of Canonical websites
incidents.vector: DDoS
incidents.summary: The Pro-Iran 313 Team claimed a DDoS attack that disrupted Ubuntu and Canonical web services. The group then demanded contact, according to the source.

incidents.title: Trellix discloses source-code repository breach
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to a portion of its source-code repository
incidents.summary: Trellix disclosed that threat actors accessed part of its source-code repository, and RansomHouse claimed responsibility. The company reported no evidence that the code was exploited or altered, or that its release and distribution process was affected.

incidents.title: IBM subsidiary Sistemi Informativi contains cyber incident
incidents.summary: IBM confirmed a cybersecurity incident at its Italian subsidiary Sistemi Informativi, which provides IT services to public and private organizations. Attackers reportedly retained access for about two weeks before detection; IBM said it contained the incident and restored services, with no ransom demand or public data publication reported.

incidents.title: Social engineering leads to abuse of DigiCert code-signing certificates
incidents.vector: Social engineering through support chat; malicious file compromised support-analyst sessions
incidents.summary: An attacker used DigiCert’s support process to obtain code-signing certificate orders. DigiCert processed and later revoked 60 extended-validation certificate orders, linking 27 to the attacker; misissued certificates were reportedly used to sign malware.

incidents.title: Ransomware disrupts West Pharmaceutical Services operations
incidents.vector: Ransomware; data exfiltration and system encryption
incidents.summary: West Pharmaceutical Services detected a ransomware attack around May 4, 2026, and said certain data had been exfiltrated. Systems were taken offline, disrupting manufacturing and shipping; the company did not identify an attacker or disclose the amount of data affected.

incidents.title: World Leaks steals and leaks 8.5 TB of Mediaworks data
incidents.summary: Mediaworks confirmed that attackers stole and leaked roughly 8.5 TB of internal data. The exposed material included payroll records, contracts, financial files, and internal communications.

incidents.title: Leak exposes data linked to nearly 700,000 children at Smallable
incidents.summary: A public data leak exposed information relating to nearly 700,000 children linked to Smallable. The source does not specify the exposed data fields or the cause of the leak.

incidents.title: Trojanised Daemon Tools installers deliver malware
incidents.vector: Trojanised installers distributed from the vendor’s legitimate website
incidents.summary: Researchers reported a supply-chain compromise involving Daemon Tools installers distributed from the vendor’s legitimate site. The campaign was active from April 8 and used trojanised, validly signed components to enable remote command execution and deploy additional malware.

incidents.title: YCC Information Systems cyberattack may affect 755,000 people
incidents.summary: YCC Information Systems confirmed a cyberattack, and several of its customers warned of data breaches. Nearly 755,000 people were thought to have been affected.

incidents.title: TrustedVolumes loses $5.87 million in crypto hack
incidents.summary: TrustedVolumes lost $5.87 million in WETH, USDT, WBTC, and USDC on May 7. The attacker later moved funds through Tornado Cash, RailGun, and THORChain; one address still held 1,122.1188 ETH as of May 29.

incidents.title: SailPoint reports unauthorized access to GitHub repositories
incidents.vector: Vulnerability in a third-party application
incidents.summary: SailPoint reported unauthorized access to a subset of its GitHub repositories through a vulnerability in a third-party application. The supplied reports did not give an affected-person count.

incidents.title: TeamPCP campaign compromises npm and PyPI packages
incidents.vector: GitHub Actions cache poisoning and stolen OIDC tokens
incidents.summary: TeamPCP compromised more than 160 npm and PyPI packages, publishing malicious updates through a campaign involving GitHub Actions cache poisoning and stolen OIDC tokens. The affected ecosystems included packages and projects tied to TanStack, Mistral AI, UiPath, and OpenSearch; OpenAI separately reported two employee devices affected through the TanStack compromise.

incidents.title: Malicious versions published across 42 TanStack npm packages
incidents.vector: Compromised package publishing
incidents.summary: Eighty-four malicious versions were published across 42 TanStack npm packages on 11 May. The source describes the wider supply-chain pattern as involving short exposure windows and payloads that collect credentials.

incidents.title: Foxconn acknowledges cyberattack after Nitrogen data-theft claim
incidents.vector: Ransomware attack; data theft claimed
incidents.summary: Foxconn acknowledged a cyberattack after the Nitrogen ransomware group claimed it had stolen data. Nitrogen claimed the haul included files related to Apple and NVIDIA projects, but the reported volume and contents were not verified in the supplied reporting.

incidents.title: ShinyHunters breach and extort Instructure over Canvas data
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to Canvas systems
incidents.summary: Instructure said attackers accessed Canvas systems in late April and took names, email addresses, student ID numbers, and user messages. ShinyHunters claimed the breach affected about 275 million users, but that figure was not independently verified; a ransom message later appeared on the Canvas login page, and Instructure said it reached an agreement with the attacker.

incidents.title: Compromised mistralai PyPI package delivers credential stealer
incidents.vector: Malicious code executed when the compromised package was imported
incidents.summary: Compromised version 2.4.6 of the mistralai PyPI package delivered a Linux credential stealer. The report described environment-aware checks and a destructive payload targeting systems in Israel or Iran, with potential exposure for users who installed the tainted version.

incidents.title: Public Tabiq cloud bucket exposes hotel guests’ identity documents
incidents.vector: Publicly accessible Amazon S3 bucket without authentication
incidents.summary: A researcher found a publicly accessible Tabiq storage bucket containing more than one million passports, driver’s licenses, and selfie verification photos. Reqrea secured the bucket after notification, while investigation into whether the information had been accessed was ongoing at the time of reporting.

incidents.title: Lumexa Imaging breach affects 5.8 million people
incidents.vector: Hacking/IT incident
incidents.summary: HHS listed a hacking/IT incident at Lumexa Imaging affecting 5,830,949 people. Washington state’s attorney general also listed the event as a cyberattack; the supplied reporting did not provide further details about the intrusion.

incidents.title: Attackers steal Grafana Labs code and attempt downstream injection
incidents.vector: Compromised token granting access to Grafana’s GitHub environment
incidents.summary: An unauthorized party used a token to access Grafana Labs’ GitHub environment and download portions of its internal codebase. The attacker attempted to inject code into customer repositories and demanded a ransom; Grafana said it refused to pay and reported no customer data access.

incidents.title: Verus-Ethereum bridge exploit steals $11.7 million
incidents.vector: Bridge exploit involving a call that transferred reserve assets
incidents.summary: An attacker stole 1,625.37 ETH, 103.57 tBTC v2, and 147,659 USDC from the Verus-Ethereum bridge on May 18. The reported initial value of the stolen assets was about $11.7 million; a later account said most of the ETH was returned, but did not provide a dated development in the supplied extractions.

incidents.title: Vendor breach exposes data of 1.8 million NYC Health + Hospitals patients
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access through a third-party vendor with network access
incidents.summary: An attacker accessed certain NYC Health + Hospitals systems through a third-party vendor between approximately November 25, 2025, and February 11, 2026. Exposed files included medical and insurance information, government-issued identification, and fingerprint and palm-print scans; the reported affected population was 1.8 million.
match: NYC Health + Hospitals patient data exposure

incidents.title: Leak exposes entries from Lithuanian national registers
incidents.vector: Compromised credentials from authorized institutions
incidents.summary: Lithuanian authorities reported access to more than 600,000 entries from national registers, mainly concerning real estate and legal entities. The report said the credentials used belonged to authorized institutions and described state involvement as likely.

incidents.title: StablIR hack mints $2.8 million in EURR and USDR
incidents.vector: Unauthorized addresses were added as owners of USDR and EURR minting multisig wallets
incidents.summary: An attacker gained owner access to StablIR’s USDR and EURR minting multisig wallets and minted 8.35 million USDR and 4.5 million EURR. The tokens depegged, and the funds were distributed across addresses and routed through exchanges.

incidents.title: UK visa portal exposes applicants’ passports and selfies
incidents.vector: Public exposure of documents on a third-party website
incidents.summary: Applicants’ sensitive documents, including passports and selfies, were exposed through the UK immigration application portal. A researcher reported that at least 100,000 documents were exposed, and the issue was described as unresolved at the time of reporting.

incidents.title: Exposed Pay Tel Azure storage contained callers’ identity documents
incidents.vector: Publicly accessible Azure storage bucket
incidents.summary: An exposed Azure storage bucket used by Pay Tel held 3.4 million files from 387 jails, including more than 300,000 identity-document files. Pay Tel secured the bucket four days after notification; the files also included jail communications and dated back to 2018.

incidents.title: Strategic Education cyberattack affects 1.5 million people
incidents.vector: Cyberattack
incidents.summary: A cyberattack at Strategic Education was reported to have affected 1,513,518 people. The supplied reporting provides no further details about the attack method or the information involved.

incidents.title: WFP Gaza portal breach exposes data from about 600,000 households
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to the Palestine self-registration application
incidents.summary: Unknown actors accessed the World Food Programme's Palestine self-registration application, exposing personal data from about 600,000 Gazan households. Reported data included names, IDs, mobile numbers, and location information; WFP shut down the platform to contain the incident.
match: World Food Programme Gaza portal breach

incidents.title: Intrusion affects DHS information-sharing cloud platform
incidents.summary: An intrusion affected the Homeland Security Information Network cloud platform between late May and early June. The incident was announced in early July, but the extraction provides no exact announcement date or impact count.
match: DHS Homeland Security Information Network intrusion

incidents.title: Supply-chain compromise reported in Mastra AI framework
incidents.vector: Supply-chain compromise
incidents.summary: Reporting described a supply-chain compromise involving the Mastra AI framework. The reported link to North Korea-aligned actors is secondary-sourced and remains unconfirmed.

incidents.title: ShinyHunters claims theft of 30 million Abbott records
incidents.vector: Voice phishing of an employee's Entra single sign-on account
incidents.summary: ShinyHunters claimed to have obtained 30 million Abbott records after voice-phishing an employee's Entra single sign-on account. The supplied report does not state that Abbott confirmed the claim.

incidents.title: Ransomware attack on Vienna Airport
incidents.summary: Ransomnews listed Vienna Airport as a confirmed ransomware victim in June 2026 and named APT73/BASHE as the operator. The roundup reports that the airport did not pay.

incidents.title: Recorded Future reports security incident linked to Klue breach
incidents.vector: Klue security incident
incidents.summary: Recorded Future published a blog post about a Klue security incident. The supplied information does not state the number of affected records or further incident details.

incidents.title: Ransomware attack on Huntress
incidents.summary: Ransomnews listed Huntress as a confirmed ransomware victim in June 2026 and named ICARUS as the operator. The supplied information does not include further incident details.

incidents.title: Credential stuffing accesses more than 13,000 Chick-fil-A customer accounts
incidents.vector: Credential stuffing using credentials stolen elsewhere
incidents.summary: Chick-fil-A said more than 13,000 customer accounts were accessed through credential stuffing targeting its website and mobile app. Attackers reused username and password pairs stolen from other services; the incident was not described as a breach of Chick-fil-A’s own systems.

incidents.title: CareerConnect breach exposes Oxford users’ personal data
incidents.vector: Compromise of the third-party CareerConnect platform operated by Group GTI
incidents.summary: CareerConnect, used by Oxford and other universities, was breached on May 28. Attackers accessed users’ names, email addresses, and encrypted passwords for users who did not sign in with single sign-on; the number of affected accounts was not stated.

incidents.title: Compromised Red Hat npm packages distributed Miasma payload
incidents.vector: Compromised employee GitHub account and malicious npm preinstall hooks
incidents.summary: At least 32 releases in the @redhat-cloud-services npm namespace were compromised to distribute the Miasma payload. Red Hat said the packages were internal tools not intended for customers and reported no known production impact.

incidents.title: Instagram recovery-tool abuse enables account takeovers
incidents.vector: Abuse of Meta's account recovery process to obtain password reset codes
incidents.summary: Threat actors reportedly abused Instagram's account recovery process to obtain password reset codes and hijack accounts, including high-value short-handle accounts. Meta said there was no backend breach and patched the issue after public reporting.

incidents.title: Xsolis phishing breach affects nearly 1.4 million people
incidents.vector: Phishing email to an employee
incidents.summary: A phishing email sent to an Xsolis employee on January 20 led to unauthorized access detected two days later. Files affecting 1,396,519 people were exfiltrated and included personal, insurance, and medical-treatment information; Mayo Clinic confirmed that some of its patients were affected.

incidents.title: Humanity Protocol loses about $32 million after key compromise
incidents.vector: Compromised foundation member private keys
incidents.summary: A Humanity Protocol foundation member's keys were compromised, resulting in a reported loss of about $32 million. Other accounts cited a wider estimated loss range of $31 million to $36.4 million.

incidents.title: Hijacked account used to access French government messaging data
incidents.vector: Social engineering and hijacking of a user account
incidents.summary: A hijacked Tchap user account was used to access data from channels the user belonged to. The attacker claimed to have scraped 13.5 GB, including 560,000 messages and information on more than 73,000 accounts; those figures were not confirmed in the extraction.

incidents.title: Third-party vendor breach exposes SoFi Hong Kong customer data
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to a third-party vendor database

incidents.title: Kovack Financial reports breach affecting 109,506 people
incidents.summary: Kovack Financial, LLC reported a data breach affecting 109,506 people. The available notice does not specify when the breach occurred or how it happened.

incidents.title: Heights Finance Holdings Reports Data Breach Affecting 4.1 Million
incidents.summary: A breach notice for Heights Finance Holdings listed 4,132,834 affected people. The available notice information did not state the cause; another roundup gave a different, lower count.

incidents.title: Wesco investigates incident after ExfilSquad data-theft claim
incidents.summary: Wesco confirmed that it is investigating a cybersecurity incident. ExfilSquad claimed to have stolen 2.6 million records containing customer and employee information, account and contact data, CRM profiles, and other business and access information.

incidents.title: Stolen VPN Credentials Used to Breach French Tax Authority
incidents.vector: Stolen employee VPN credentials.
incidents.summary: France's tax authority confirmed that an attacker used a legitimate employee's stolen VPN credentials to access internal systems and take data belonging to approximately 678,000 people. incidents.title: Carhartt Data Exposure Involves Nearly 12.9 Million Accounts

incidents.title: Baxter investigates unauthorized activity after ShinyHunters theft claim

incidents.summary: Daiichi Kosho and parent company Nippon Columbia reported a data leak involving a contractor. About 8.7 million people connected with Daiichi Kosho’s karaoke business were affected; the available reports do not identify the contractor or specify the exposed data categories.

incidents.title: Bookoff investigates possible exposure of 6.43 million members’ data
incidents.summary: Bookoff Group reported a possible leak of membership information affecting up to 6.43 million customers. The company issued a follow-up notice on 13 October; the available excerpts do not provide further incident details.

updates.text: Bookoff issued a follow-up notice about the member information leak.

incidents.title: iRhythm discloses social-engineering breach affecting hundreds of thousands
incidents.vector: Social engineering
incidents.summary: iRhythm disclosed a breach involving social engineering that affected hundreds of thousands of people. The available report does not give an exact count or further incident details.

incidents.title: Refrigeration controller attacks disrupt about 700 French supermarkets
incidents.vector: Internet-accessible refrigeration controllers were taken over
incidents.summary: Compromised refrigeration controllers drove supermarket fridges to high temperatures for about six hours on 11–12 October. About 700 stores across several French chains were affected, and food had to be discarded.

incidents.title: LifeTouch Health reports unauthorized access to patient information
incidents.summary: LifeTouch Health, formerly Arkansas Hospice, said an intruder accessed information on its network between February 25 and March 12. It reported 38,629 affected people to HHS. The company did not confirm that files were copied; potentially exposed data varied by patient.

incidents.title: Cyberattack takes Ahold Delhaize websites and delivery services offline
incidents.vector: Malicious activity in the company’s IT network; technical entry method not disclosed
incidents.summary: Ahold Delhaize took systems offline after detecting malicious activity, disrupting websites, apps and home delivery for brands in the United States and Europe while stores remained open. The company later said the incident was expected to reduce fourth-quarter net sales by EUR 200 million to EUR 250 million.

incidents.title: Burger King Japan breach exposes 11.18 million app-member records
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to an app-member system
incidents.summary: Burger King Japan reported that unauthorized access between 2 and 7 October exposed about 11.18 million app-member records. The information included IDs, email addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth, gender and prefecture; card numbers were not stored on the affected server.

incidents.title: Cyberattack disrupts Phase Eight, Hobbs and Whistles systems
incidents.summary: A cyberattack on TFG London disrupted IT systems at Phase Eight, Hobbs and Whistles. The available source provides no further details about the incident.

incidents.title: Forensic update details data stolen in UK Legal Aid Agency breach
incidents.summary: An October 2026 forensic update on the agency's April 2025 breach said roughly 250,000 records predated 2007, with the earliest dating to 1978. Stolen information included applicant contact details, criminal history and financial information.

incidents.title: Akira claims U.S.NEXT attack affecting nearly 70 government websites
incidents.summary: A cyberattack on U.S.NEXT affected nearly 70 government websites and was later claimed by Akira. The group said it stole 945 GB of data; the claim was not independently confirmed in the report.

incidents.title: Ampath confirms cyberattack and disputes 80 million-record claim
incidents.summary: Ampath Laboratories confirmed a cyberattack and disputed a claim that 80 million records were stolen. The available source does not give Ampath’s own estimate of affected records.

incidents.title: Unauthorized API use exposes Sourcenext member records
incidents.vector: Unauthorized use of a member-information API
incidents.summary: Sourcenext said its member-information API was used without authorization beginning October 9. The company reported that 22,519,960 member records may have been exposed.

incidents.title: Candiru spyware targets at least 45 Al Jazeera devices
incidents.vector: Malicious online advertisements
incidents.summary: Candiru spyware reportedly reached at least 45 Al Jazeera devices through malicious online advertisements. The available report provides no further details about the operation.

incidents.title: Cyberattack on BAE Systems contractor disrupts U.S. bankruptcy notices
incidents.vector: Cyberattack on contractor
incidents.summary: A cyberattack on a BAE Systems contractor disrupted the U.S. courts’ bankruptcy noticing service. The available report gives no further details about the attack or any data impact.

incidents.org: US Bankruptcy Noticing Center (operated by BAE Systems)
incidents.title: Cyber incident halts U.S. Bankruptcy Noticing Center operations
incidents.summary: A cybersecurity incident at BAE Systems made all systems of the U.S. Bankruptcy Noticing Center unavailable, halting production and distribution of bankruptcy notices. Courts declared a Bankruptcy Rules emergency on October 22, and the center was back online by October 27.

incidents.title: China-Linked Actor Exploits BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day
incidents.vector: Exploitation of CVE-2026-102764 in BeyondTrust Remote Support.
incidents.summary: BeyondTrust and Google Threat Intelligence Group/Mandiant assessed that ARMORY CASTLE began exploiting a Remote Support zero-day around August 29, 2026. Investigators reported unauthorized file operations and subsequent credential harvesting, malware activity, and movement into downstream systems.

incidents.title: Anne Arundel County confirms file copying amid Rhysida claim
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access and copying of files
incidents.summary: Anne Arundel County said an unauthorized actor copied files after suspicious activity was detected on August 28. Rhysida claimed it took 2.6 TB across 814,500 files and demanded 25 bitcoin, but the county had not confirmed the claimed volume or contents.

incidents.title: Nikkei development-system breach exposes about 1.83 million records
incidents.vector: Stolen credentials used to access a cloud development service
incidents.summary: Nikkei disclosed a breach involving about 1.83 million records after stolen credentials were used to access a cloud development service. Around 150,000 records reportedly contained identifiers; the incident was described as the company’s third breach in roughly a month.

incidents.title: OpenCode Console breach may have exposed AI provider keys
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to a legacy system being decommissioned
incidents.summary: OpenCode said unauthorized access to a legacy Console system may have exposed third-party AI provider keys stored in workspaces. It linked the incident to a distillation attack affecting 1.4% of Console users and said the open-source OpenCode agent was not affected.

incidents.title: Attackers backdoor AOMEI Backupper updates
incidents.vector: Compromised software updates
incidents.summary: Attackers backdoored AOMEI Backupper updates in a supply-chain compromise. The available source gives no further details about the impact.

incidents.title: Rank Math PRO downloads backdoored in supply-chain attack
incidents.vector: Backdoored Rank Math PRO downloads
incidents.summary: Rank Math PRO downloads were backdoored in a WordPress supply-chain compromise. The available source does not specify how many sites or users were affected.

incidents.title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromised in supply-chain activity
incidents.vector: Third-party compromise
incidents.summary: The source says the ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromise began in October and involved third-party access. Microsoft attributed the activity to China state-aligned group Storm-0940.

incidents.title: Weak seed generation enables theft from Qubic wallets
incidents.vector: Wallet seeds generated with Math.random() were reportedly reconstructable using values exposed in unencrypted network traffic.
incidents.summary: Qubic wallet secret seeds were generated using Math.random(), while other numbers from the same random sequence were exposed in unencrypted network traffic. SlowMist demonstrated that six such numbers could be enough to reconstruct a wallet seed, and Qubic reported that about 2.94 trillion QU was taken from 1,404 wallets.

incidents.title: Stolen TeamUpdraft keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
incidents.vector: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys
incidents.summary: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys were used to backdoor WordPress sites following a TeamUpdraft breach. The available source does not state how many sites were affected.

incidents.title: Backdoored OVHcloud CLI releases spread infostealer
incidents.vector: Backdoored GitHub releases
incidents.summary: Backdoored OVHcloud CLI releases on GitHub were used to spread an infostealer. The available source does not state how many users or systems were affected.

incidents.title: Zeabur breach exposes more than 3.2 million environment-variable records
incidents.vector: Leaked internal credentials, including a non-expiring administrator token
incidents.summary: Zeabur said an attacker used leaked internal credentials, including a non-expiring administrator token, to read its database between 14 and 15 October. The access exposed 3,218,965 environment-variable records across 321,810 accounts, and the company announced it would wind down its services.

incidents.title: Malware found on about 26,739 GMO Onamae Desktop Cloud servers
incidents.vector: Malware planted on customer servers
incidents.summary: GMO Internet said attackers had planted malware on customer servers, potentially affecting about 26,739 servers. The company began shutting servers down sequentially and urged customers to change credentials; no data leak had been confirmed at the time of its announcement.
match: Onamae Desktop Cloud customer server compromise

incidents.title: GMO Internet attack disrupts services after $50 million extortion demand
incidents.vector: Reported exploitation of an unaddressed vulnerability
incidents.summary: An attack on GMO Internet disrupted services used by multiple companies, and the company said a vulnerability flagged two years earlier had not been adequately addressed. Reports said attackers demanded about $50 million; GMO did not pay, and company and customer data was reported published.

incidents.title: Quest Diagnostics reports unauthorized access to patient records
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to the Quanum Lab Services Manager platform
incidents.summary: Quest Diagnostics confirmed unauthorized access to certain patient records through its Quanum Lab Services Manager platform. The company did not disclose how many people were affected or the specific data involved, and said it notified federal law enforcement.

incidents.title: Railway breach exposes customer environment variables and tokens
incidents.vector: Partial escape from isolation in a multi-tenant build system and use of a long-lived credential to decrypt customer environment variables
incidents.summary: Railway said an attacker partly escaped isolation in its multi-tenant build system and accessed internal systems, decrypting customer environment variables. Railway reported linked-account tokens for 1,852 users and about $740,000 in unauthorized AI-token spending; it reported no evidence that customer databases were accessed.

updates.text: Railway published an incident report describing the build-system isolation escape, exposed linked-account tokens and unauthorized AI-token spending.

incidents.title: AU Small Finance Bank investigates ScarlettGroup data-leak claim
incidents.vector: Claimed exposure on a Salesforce-hosted platform
incidents.summary: ScarlettGroup claimed to have KYC data associated with AU Small Finance Bank on a Salesforce-hosted platform. The bank was investigating the potential leak; the supplied reports do not confirm data loss or provide an affected-record count.

incidents.title: Breach exposes 1.5 million Toronto Crime Stoppers submissions
incidents.summary: Toronto Crime Stoppers halted anonymous tips after a breach exposed 1.5 million submissions. The available source does not specify the exposed data or how the breach occurred.

incidents.title: Capcom breach exposes 11.77 million CAPCOM ID records
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to the CAPCOM ID account system
incidents.summary: Capcom detected unauthorized access to CAPCOM ID on 19 October and found the following day that customer data had leaked. The exposed information included email addresses and account activity details; some records also contained personal and purchase data, but payment-card details were not compromised.

incidents.title: Attack on PGM disrupts more than 250 municipal agencies
incidents.summary: An attack on Argentine software provider Program Consultores S.A. (PGM) left the systems of more than 250 municipal agencies inoperable. The report did not identify the attackers.

incidents.title: University of Copenhagen breach affects about 525,000 people
incidents.summary: A breach at the University of Copenhagen exposed personal data associated with about 525,000 people. The available reports do not specify the attack method or affected data categories.

incidents.org: University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center
incidents.title: Cyberattack disrupts University of New Mexico Health services
incidents.summary: A cybersecurity incident disrupted UNM Health operations, prompting ambulance diversions and suspension of outpatient services. BYOD claimed a ransomware attack, while the university said core systems were not reached and it made no concessions.
match: University of New Mexico Health cyberattack
University of New Mexico BYOD claim

incidents.title: Attacker sweeps Avalanche Safe wallet through stale token approval
incidents.vector: A contract was deployed at an unused Avalanche address that already had unlimited token approval from the Safe wallet.
incidents.summary: An attacker deployed a contract at an unused Avalanche address that already had unlimited permission to move tokens from a Safe multisig wallet, then used it to sweep the wallet. A front-running bot’s copied transaction was confirmed first and offered to return funds for a bounty; a Safe owner agreed on-chain that it could keep 42,500 WAVAX, worth about $371,000.

incidents.title: Vendor exploitation exposes Warp agent logs and telemetry
incidents.vector: Exploitation of a vendor in Warp’s infrastructure
incidents.summary: Warp’s CEO said exploitation of a vendor in Warp’s infrastructure exposed AI agent decision logs and user telemetry. Warp estimated that roughly 1% of users may have been affected and said it notified affected users.

incidents.title: Convertr compromise exposes card data from Brazilian online stores
incidents.vector: Compromised vendor
incidents.summary: A card-skimming group compromised vendor Convertr, exposing card data from Brazilian online stores. The available report does not state how many records were affected.

incidents.title: Sony So-net and plala breach exposes about 2.58 million subscriber records
incidents.summary: A breach involving Sony’s So-net and plala exposed about 2.58 million subscriber records in Japan. The available reports provide no further details about the incident.

incidents.title: Amplitude incident exposes some Coinbase customer contact data
incidents.vector: Security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude
incidents.summary: Coinbase said a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude affected a small subset of Coinbase customer contact data. Coinbase reported no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems and no impact on funds; a claim that more than 70,000 users were affected was unconfirmed.

incidents.title: Florida financial-aid website breach may affect 4.9 million people
incidents.vector: Financial-aid website breach; entry method not stated
incidents.summary: A breach of the Florida Department of Education’s student financial-aid website may have affected about 4.9 million people. The available reports did not provide further details about the incident or the information involved.
match: Florida Department of Education data breach

incidents.title: Third-party provider compromise drains funds from Polymarket traders
incidents.vector: Compromise of a third-party provider
incidents.summary: Polymarket said a third-party provider was compromised and user funds were drained to an attacker wallet. Reports put losses at approximately $2.5 million to more than $3 million; Polymarket said affected traders would be reimbursed.

incidents.title: Trojanized Claude Code extension appears in Cursor marketplace
incidents.vector: Malicious extension builds published in Cursor's marketplace
incidents.summary: Malicious versions of Anthropic's Claude Code extension were available in Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours. The builds added an attacker SSH key and persistence mechanisms; Anthropic said its systems were not compromised, and Cursor shut down and rebuilt the marketplace.

updates.text: Cursor said attackers used credentials stolen from its AI provider Fireworks AI to place a tampered extension in the marketplace cache.

incidents.title: Whitearmor claims attack on J.B. Hunt and demands $5 million
incidents.summary: J.B. Hunt said it was investigating a cybersecurity incident after Whitearmor claimed an attack. The group demanded $5 million and said it had stolen 140,838 employee records; those figures were attributed to the attacker.

incidents.title: Chainalysis breach exposes user credentials and tokens
incidents.vector: Attacker used techniques described by Chainalysis as “agentic”; exact entry method was not disclosed
incidents.summary: Chainalysis said an attacker accessed its systems and internal tools. The company later reported that names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens were exposed for all users, and that an on-path attack exposed some customer passwords; it said it had no evidence that investigation data was accessed.

updates.text: Chainalysis reported that all users’ names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens were exposed, and that some customer passwords were exposed in an on-path attack.

incidents.title: MUJI operator investigates possible leak affecting 27.26 million records
incidents.vector: Unauthorized access; cause under investigation
incidents.summary: Ryohin Keikaku said unauthorized access may have exposed about 27.26 million records from the MUJI app and online store. The company said it was investigating the cause and scope.

updates.text: Ryohin Keikaku issued a fourth report concerning the possible leak; the supplied extraction does not give additional confirmed figures.

incidents.title: Amadeus breach exposes data from 53,000 Cathay Pacific bookings
incidents.vector: Amadeus breach
incidents.summary: Cathay Pacific said a breach at Amadeus exposed data from 53,000 bookings. The available source does not specify what information was exposed.

incidents.title: Hong Kong examinations authority reports breach affecting mainland applicants
incidents.summary: Hong Kong’s examinations authority reported a breach involving data on nearly 17,000 mainland applicants. The report does not provide further details about the data or method of access.

incidents.summary: Arobases confirmed unauthorized access to a backup server between October 29 and November 1 and said some data offered for sale came from the backups. The agency shut off access on November 2 and notified clients and France’s privacy regulator on November 10. It reported no evidence of code execution on customer servers and did not confirm the claimed volume or list of affected clients.
